M.name: Tidal limit (est.)
M.src: Generic extrapolation 1.8 km beyond the last calibration: median lag growth of all calibrated QLD places/gauges in this region (HW +2.0, LW +3.2 min/km); at a natural tidal limit highs ≈ 0.15 m lower than downstream and lows drain out (water-starts-rising, like upper Baffle)
